statement.en: The possible relative to what is held grows only across steps changing what is held, and keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Along a course of a stated process nothing is added to the whole possible, a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top included.
statement.zh: 相对于所持守者之可能，仅于改变所持守者之步上增长，仅当所持守者无尽地改变时持续扩大。沿一陈述之过程之进程，全部可能无所增，改变自身规则之规则与无顶之规则塔亦然。

laws.en: A move adds nothing to the possible under its process. For any process Q, what is possible under Q from a configuration Q reaches is possible from the first; so where something possible under Q from t is not possible from s, Q does not reach t from s, and a step from s to t is not a move of Q.
laws.zh: 一步不给其过程下之可能增添任何东西。对任一过程 Q，自 Q 所达之构型在 Q 下可能者，自起点亦可能；故自 t 在 Q 下可能而自 s 不可能者若有，则 Q 不自 s 达 t，自 s 至 t 之步非 Q 之步。

laws.en: Keeping widening needs departures without end. Along a course, where every step of a stretch is a move of Q, what is possible under Q at its end is possible at its start; so where the possible under Q keeps widening, read from the course's first step, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of moves of Q throughout, and where every step from some step on is one, it does not keep widening.
laws.zh: 持续扩大需无尽之偏离。沿一进程，一段中每步皆 Q 之步时，段末在 Q 下可能者段首亦可能；故 Q 下之可能自首步读而持续扩大时，自每一步起总有一有界之段不全由 Q 之步组成；自某步起每步皆为 Q 之步时，它不持续扩大。

laws.en: A course that returns. Along a course that comes back to one configuration at arbitrarily late steps, nothing read off its configurations keeps widening: neither the possible under any process nor the possible with any part held.
laws.zh: 回返之进程。沿一于任意晚之步回到同一构型之进程，自其构型所读之任何东西皆不持续扩大：任一过程下之可能、持守任一部分时之可能皆然。

laws.en: The possible with a part held. For a relation Same on configurations, read as a part held unchanged, the moves holding it are the moves of the process with Same between their two configurations, and the held possible is the possible under them; it is included in the whole possible, and holding a weaker relation reaches at least as much.
laws.zh: 持守一部分时之可能。构型上之关系 Same 读作不变地持守之部分；持守之之步即两构型间有 Same 之过程之步，持守时之可能即其下之可能；它含于全部可能之中，持守较弱之关系所达不少于此。

laws.en: Instances. Onward's steps within a family are the moves holding both ends in it, and Junctures' steps after which a configuration can still be had are the moves holding that, both by definition.
laws.zh: 实例。Onward 之族内之步即持守两端皆在族中之步，Junctures 之其后某构型仍可得之步即持守此者之步，皆依定义。

laws.en: On the root. With Same in the place of the grammar's class, any relation, a move holding it is a continuation «续» under it; what the moves holding it reach is the start or the start's line «相续» under it; and the held possible is what the start or that line admits.
laws.zh: 于根上。以 Same 居语法之类之位（任一关系皆可），持守之之步即其下之续；持守之之步所达者即起点或起点于其下之相续；持守时之可能即起点或该线所纳。

laws.en: Held move by move, and as at the start. Where Same is a class, what the moves holding it reach is alike the start under it, and holding it move by move is holding it as it is at the start, both ways: what the moves holding Same reach from s is what the moves into configurations alike s reach.
laws.zh: 逐步持守与如起点般持守。Same 为类时，持守之之步所达者于其下与起点同类，逐步持守即如起点般持守，双向皆然：自 s 持守 Same 之步所达者，即入与 s 同类之构型之步所达者。

laws.en: Where it grows. Where something possible with the part held at the next step is not possible so at the present one, the step changes the part; where every step from T on holds the part, what is possible with it held at step T + d is possible so at T: from the step at which the part stays for good, nothing is added.
laws.zh: 于何处增长。下一步持守该部分时可能而当下不然者若有，则该步改变该部分；自 T 起每步皆持守该部分时，第 T + d 步持守时可能者，于 T 亦然：自该部分永住之步起，无所增。

laws.en: Where it keeps widening. The held possible keeps widening only where the part changes without end: from every step some bounded stretch does not hold the part throughout, so not along a course whose steps hold it from some step on; and only where no list holds the whole possible from the course's start.
laws.zh: 于何处持续扩大。持守时之可能仅当该部分无尽地改变时持续扩大：自每一步起总有一有界之段不全持守之，故其步自某步起皆持守之之进程上不然；且仅当无列表自进程之始持全部可能时。

laws.en: Located where holding is decided. Where whether each step of the course holds the part is decided, a step changing it lies between N and N + d wherever something possible with it held at N + d is not possible so at N, and where the held possible keeps widening such a step recurs from every step on.
laws.zh: 持守可判定时可定位。进程每步是否持守该部分可判定时，第 N + d 步持守时可能而第 N 步不然者若有，则 N 与 N + d 之间有一步改变之；持守时之可能持续扩大时，此种步自每一步起皆复现。

laws.en: Read on the course's moments. With the part between two moments in the place of the class, where the held possible keeps widening, from no moment is the course's line under the part unending «不穷»; and where holding is also decided, a line under the part begins «生» after every moment.
laws.zh: 读于进程之时刻。以两时刻间之该部分居类之位，持守时之可能持续扩大时，进程于该部分下之线自无一时刻起不穷；持守亦可判定时，该部分下之线于每一时刻之后皆有所生。

laws.en: On the map. Read along the steps with the one as the coarse class, a moment is 全生成 at a class exactly where a line under it begins after every later moment; so where holding is decided and the held possible keeps widening, every moment is 全生成 at (the one, what is held), and so where what is held changes at every step. A restatement; not conversely.
laws.zh: 于图谱上。沿诸步读、以一为粗类，一时刻于某类全生成，恰当其下之线于每一更晚时刻之后皆有所起；故持守可判定且持守时之可能持续扩大时，每一时刻于（一，所持守者）全生成；所持守者每步皆变时亦然。重述；反之不然。

laws.en: Witnesses on the map. Every moment of the raised rule is 全生成 under the rule held while every moment ceases: generation without renewal without end. On the rule raised every other step, every moment is 全生成 beside renewal without end and keeping widening. On the oscillating rule every moment is 全生成 while the held possible does not keep widening.
laws.zh: 图谱上之见证。提升规则之每一时刻于持守规则时全生成，而每一时刻皆息：生成而无 «生生»。隔步提升之规则上，每一时刻全生成，与 «生生» 及持续扩大并存。振荡之规则上每一时刻全生成，而持守时之可能不持续扩大。

laws.en: A rule changing its own rule. On adaptive F G a step keeps the rule exactly where G leaves it as it is; so the possible with the rule held keeps widening only where G changes the rule without end, located from every step on where rules are decided; nothing is added to the whole possible (Run.possible_of_next at adaptive F G).
laws.zh: 改变自身规则之规则。于 adaptive F G 上，一步保持规则，恰当 G 使之不变时；故持守规则时之可能仅当 G 无尽地改变规则时持续扩大，规则可判定时自每一步起可定位；全部可能无所增（Run.possible_of_next 于 adaptive F G）。

laws.en: Every possibility with some member of a sequence held. On the root, for every carrier and relation R: on a sequence of relations E n, each included in every later one, where every step of R is alike under some member, whatever R reaches lies on a line under some member; so where every move of a process holds some member, what it reaches it reaches with some member held, and so every possibility.
laws.zh: 持守某一序列成员时之每一可能。于根上，对每一载体与关系 R：于关系之列 E n（每项含于其后每项）上，R 之每步皆于某成员下同类时，R 所及者落于某成员下之线上；故过程之每步皆持守某成员时，其所达者于持守某成员时可达，每一可能亦然，反之亦然。

laws.en: A tower of rules with no top. A state and a sequence of rules: the move 0 changes the state as the rule at height 0 allows, the move k + 1 the rule at height k as the rule at height k + 1 allows, all else kept, so each rule changes only as the one above it allows. The move a keeps the rules from height a up, a class coarser with the height, so each possibility is had with the rules from some height up held.
laws.zh: 无顶之规则塔。构型为一状态与一列规则；步 0 依高度 0 之规则改变状态，步 k + 1 依高度 k + 1 之规则改变高度 k 之规则，余皆保持：每一规则仅依其上者所允而变。步 a 保持高度 a 以上之规则，此类随高度渐粗，故每一可能皆可于持守某高度以上诸规则时得之，反之亦然。

laws.en: The premise is needed. The same scheme changing every rule at once has a possibility needing the whole tower: with each rule growing by the one above it, 2 is possible from all rules at 1, but not with the rules from any height up held, each move changing every rule.
laws.zh: 前提不可少。同一方案而同时改变每一规则者，有需整座塔之可能：每一规则皆加其上者时，自诸规则皆为 1 处 2 可能，然持守任一高度以上之规则时不可能，因每步皆改变每一规则。

laws.en: Along a course of the tower. Where the possible with the rules from height n up held keeps widening, moves above n, the only moves that can change a rule from height n up, recur from every step on, located with no decision of the rules since each move names the one height it can change; the moves at most n reflect that possible, so every origin of it passes a move above n (Gated.origin).
laws.zh: 沿塔之进程。持守高度 n 以上之规则而可能持续扩大时，高于 n 之步（唯一能改高度 n 以上规则者）自每一步起复现，无需判定规则即可定位，因每步名其唯一能改之高度；至多 n 之步反映该可能，故其每一起源皆经一高于 n 之步（Gated.origin）。

laws.en: Witness: a raised rule. A configuration is a rule n and a position x; a move raises the rule by one or moves the position to any x' at most n; (n, x) admits x. Along the course raising the rule at every step, the possible with the rule held at step k is what lies at most k, so it keeps widening, while every formation is possible from every configuration; the rule changes at every step.
laws.zh: 见证：逐步提升之规则。构型为规则 n 与位置 x；一步或将规则加一，或将位置移至任一至多 n 之 x'；(n, x) 纳 x。沿每步提升规则之进程，第 k 步持守规则时之可能即至多 k 者，故持续扩大，而自每一构型每一构成皆可能；规则每步皆改变。

laws.en: Witness: endless change does not suffice. A move sets the rule to any value or moves the position to any value at most the rule. Along the course alternating the rule between 0 and 1, the rule changes at every step and every formation is possible from every configuration, so no list holds the whole possible, yet the possible with the rule held does not keep widening.
laws.zh: 见证：无尽之改变不足。一步或将规则设为任一值，或将位置移至任一至多该规则之值。沿规则于 0 与 1 间交替之进程，规则每步皆改变，自每一构型每一构成皆可能，故无列表持全部可能，然持守规则时之可能不持续扩大。

laws.en: Witness: a course that only returns. The alternating course returns every two steps, so its first configuration comes back at arbitrarily late steps; at every step the whole possible exceeds what is admitted, and the possible with the rule held widens across the first step; yet it does not keep widening.
laws.zh: 见证：只回返之进程。交替之进程每两步回返，故其首构型于任意晚之步复现；每一步全部可能皆超出所纳，持守规则时之可能于首步上扩大；然其不持续扩大。

laws.en: Witness: a tower copying down. The move k + 1 copies the rule at height k + 1 down to height k, the move 0 changing nothing; x is admitted where the rule at height x is above x + 1. Along the course copying down to height k at step k, the possible with the rules from height n up held is what lies below n or k: it keeps widening for every n, every formation stays possible, and each rule changes once.
laws.zh: 见证：向下复制之塔。步 k + 1 将高度 k + 1 之规则复制至高度 k，步 0 无所改；高度 x 之规则大于 x + 1 处纳 x。沿第 k 步复制至高度 k 之进程，持守高度 n 以上之规则时之可能即小于 n 或小于 k 者，故对每一 n 持续扩大，而每一构成始终可能；每一规则只改变一次。

laws.en: Witnesses cease under what is held. Read on the course's moments under the rule held, no moment of the raised rule's course renews «复生», and under the rules from any height up held no moment of the copying course does; so every moment of both ceases «息» («自不复生则息»), while the held possible keeps widening.
laws.zh: 见证于所持守者下皆息。读于进程之时刻，持守规则时提升规则之进程无一时刻复生，持守任一高度以上之规则时复制之进程亦然；故二者每一时刻皆息（自不复生则息），而持守时之可能持续扩大。

laws.en: Witness: growth relative to what is held with renewal without end. On the raised rule's process, along the course raising the rule across every even step and keeping it across every odd one, the possible with the rule held keeps widening, every formation stays possible, and, read on the moments under the rule held, renewal without end «生生» holds at every even moment, so moment 0 does not cease «生生不息».
laws.zh: 见证：相对于所持守者之增长与 «生生» 并存。于提升规则之过程上，沿偶数步提升规则、奇数步保持之进程，持守规则时之可能持续扩大，自每一构型每一构成皆可能；读于持守规则时之时刻，每一偶数时刻皆 «生生»，故时刻 0 不息（«生生不息»）。

laws.en: Witness: off a class the two readings of holding differ. For adjacent-or-equal, which is not transitive, the moves holding it reach 2 from 0, and 2 is not alike 0; for at-most, which is not symmetric, holding it as at the start reaches 3 from 0, and holding it move by move does not.
laws.zh: 见证：非类之关系上两种持守之读相异。相邻或相等非传递：持守之之步自 0 达 2，而 2 与 0 不同；至多非对称：如起点般持守自 0 达 3，逐步持守则否。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each law holds on every process with what each configuration admits given, or on a witness; the located forms take holding decided along the course, or rules decided; the sequence law takes each member included in every later one and every move holding some member.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每一律于每一过程（各构型所纳给定）或于一见证上成立；可定位之形需沿进程持守可判定，或规则可判定；序列之律需每一成员含于其后每一成员，且每步皆持守某一成员。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete steps; the held part a relation on configurations read move by move, the same as holding it as at the start for a class, not in general; formations compared by name over one fixed type; keeping widening read from the course's first step; the tower's rules a sequence indexed by the natural numbers, each move keeping the rules from some height up, its scheme fixed.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选：离散之步；所持守之部分为构型上之关系，逐步读之，对类而言与如起点般持守相同，一般则否；构成在一固定类型上按名比较；持续扩大自进程首步读；塔之规则为以自然数为索引之列，每步保持某高度以上之规则，其方案固定。

does_not_show.en: That growth relative to what is held is growth of the whole possible: along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows.
does_not_show.zh: 相对于所持守者之增长即全部可能之增长：沿一陈述之过程之进程，全部可能从不增长。

does_not_show.en: A sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held, beyond the witnesses: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice.
does_not_show.zh: 相对于所持守者持续扩大之充分条件（见证之外）：无尽之改变加无列表之全部可能并不足够。

does_not_show.en: Where a change of a general part is located without deciding each step's holding: the law then gives a bounded stretch not holding it throughout, not a step.
does_not_show.zh: 不判定每步之持守时一般部分之改变位于何处：此时律只给出一不全持守之有界之段，非一步。

does_not_show.en: That a move above n changes a rule: the tower's law locates moves that can change a rule from height n up, not a change.
does_not_show.zh: 高于 n 之步改变一规则：塔之律所定位者为能改变高度 n 以上规则之步，非改变本身。

does_not_show.en: A change of the law of change with no fixed scheme, or a space of rules not given with the carrier: the tower's scheme is fixed, as the law of any stated process is.
does_not_show.zh: 无固定方案之变化律之变化，或不随载体给出之规则空间：塔之方案固定，如任一陈述之过程之律。

does_not_show.en: Whether the actual unfolding is a course of a process statable in advance; the possible that cannot be prestated is outside.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之展开是否为一可预先陈述之过程之进程；不可预先陈述之可能在外。

does_not_show.en: That growth relative to what is held is better or is the direction of 生生: ranking needs C, and the reading of 生生不息 here is an AI reading.
does_not_show.zh: 相对于所持守者之增长更好或即生生之方向：排序需要 C，此处对生生不息之读为 AI 之读。

does_not_show.en: A result no neighbouring field states: the held law restates open-ended novelty's innovation, and the tower law the finite degree of introspection of reflective towers.
does_not_show.zh: 近邻领域无人陈述之结果：持守之律重述开放式新颖之创新，塔之律重述反射塔之有限内省度。

detail.en: The rule changes at every step and every formation is possible everywhere, yet the possible with the rule held does not keep widening (Oscillating.converse_fails). Every moment is 全生成 under the rule held, so 全生成 does not give keeping widening (Oscillating.generation_without_widening).
detail.zh: 规则每步皆改变，处处每一构成皆可能，然持守规则时之可能不持续扩大（Oscillating.converse_fails）。每一时刻于持守规则时皆全生成，故全生成不给出持续扩大（Oscillating.generation_without_widening）。

detail.en: With every rule changed at once, 2 is possible from all rules at 1 but not with the rules from any height up held (Synchronous.tower_law_fails).
detail.zh: 每一规则同时改变时，自诸规则皆为 1 处 2 可能，然持守任一高度以上之规则时不可能（Synchronous.tower_law_fails）。

detail.en: Each rule changes once, yet the possible with the rules from every height up held keeps widening (CopyDown.changes_iff, CopyDown.held_keeps_widening).
detail.zh: 每一规则只改变一次，然持守每一高度以上之规则时之可能持续扩大（CopyDown.changes_iff、CopyDown.held_keeps_widening）。

detail.en: The possible with the rule held keeps widening while every formation is possible from every configuration of the course (RaisedRule.held_keeps_widening, RaisedRule.whole_every).
detail.zh: 持守规则时之可能持续扩大，而自进程之每一构型每一构成皆可能（RaisedRule.held_keeps_widening、RaisedRule.whole_every）。

detail.en: A course returning every two steps has the whole possible exceeding what is admitted at every step and the held possible widening across a step, yet it does not keep widening (Oscillating.returning_has_both).
detail.zh: 每两步回返之进程，每一步全部可能皆超出所纳，持守时之可能于一步上扩大，然不持续扩大（Oscillating.returning_has_both）。

detail.en: The held possible keeps widening while every moment ceases under what is held (RaisedRule.ceases, CopyDown.ceases).
detail.zh: 持守时之可能持续扩大，而于所持守者下每一时刻皆息（RaisedRule.ceases、CopyDown.ceases）。

detail.en: For a relation that is not transitive, the moves holding it reach what is not alike the start; for one that is not symmetric, holding it as at the start reaches what holding it move by move does not (AdjacentHeld.differs, OrderHeld.differs).
detail.zh: 非传递之关系，持守之之步所达者可与起点不同；非对称之关系，如起点般持守所达者，逐步持守未必达（AdjacentHeld.differs、OrderHeld.differs）。

next_delta.en: A change of the law of change with no fixed scheme, or a space of rules not given with the carrier; a sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 无固定方案之变化律之变化，或不随载体给出之规则空间；相对于所持守者持续扩大之充分条件；人之审查。

correspondence.en: The held law restates open-ended novelty's innovation, novelty that changes the model and with it the possibilities of variation (Banzhaf and others 2016), which holds there by definition, as a law on any process. Continuing inheritable change at the highest levels, which McMullin proposed at the York workshop (Taylor and others 2016), is the informal neighbour of a top fixed for good stopping the growth relative to it; innovation against fixed-rule systems, found with state-dependent rules (Adams, Zenil, Davies and Walker 2017), is a neighbour of the rule changing its own rule, not the same statement. The tower law's finite support is, in substance, the finite degree of introspection that lets an infinite tower of reflective processors be implemented (des Rivières and Smith 1984; Wand and Friedman 1988), restated with its premise shown needed; Bateson's levels of learning (1972) are the tower's scheme with no law of possibility. The possible that cannot be prestated (Kauffman 2000; Longo, Montévil and Kauffman 2012) is outside, and open-endedness relative to an observer (Hughes and others 2024) is an analogue on the side of novelty. Graded in UE11's NOTE.
correspondence.zh: 持守之律把开放式新颖之创新（改变模型从而改变变异之可能者之新颖，Banzhaf 等 2016；彼处依定义成立）重述为任一过程上之律。McMullin 于 York 研讨会所提最高层级之持续可遗传改变（Taylor 等 2016）是顶部永固则相对于之增长止之非形式近邻；以依赖状态之规则所得之、相对于固定规则系统之创新（Adams、Zenil、Davies 与 Walker 2017）是改变自身规则之规则之近邻，非同一陈述。塔之律之有限支撑，实质上即使无穷反射处理器之塔可实现之有限内省度（des Rivières 与 Smith 1984；Wand 与 Friedman 1988），此处重述并示其前提不可少；Bateson 之学习层级（1972）即无可能之律之塔之方案。不可预先陈述之可能（Kauffman 2000；Longo、Montévil 与 Kauffman 2012）在外，相对于观察者之开放性（Hughes 等 2024）为新颖一侧之类比。分级见 UE11 之 NOTE。

aliases: the possible relative to what is held
a tower of rules with no top

detail.en: Reaching.Possible, Reaching.Possible.of_reach, Reaching.KeepsWidening, Reaching.KeepsWidening.not_listed, Run.possible_of_next and Run.possible_from_start: the possible, nothing added to it along a course, and keeping widening as a chain.
detail.zh: Reaching.Possible、Reaching.Possible.of_reach、Reaching.KeepsWidening、Reaching.KeepsWidening.not_listed、Run.possible_of_next 与 Run.possible_from_start：可能者、沿进程其无所增、以链读之持续扩大。

detail.en: adaptive, a state going on under a rule that itself goes on.
detail.zh: adaptive，一状态于自身亦延续之规则下延续。

detail.en: Gated.ReflectedBy and Gated.origin: the held possible of the tower reflected by the moves at most a height, and every origin of it passing a move above.
detail.zh: Gated.ReflectedBy 与 Gated.origin：塔之持守时之可能为至多某高度之步所反映，其每一起源皆经一更高之步。

detail.en: Onward.within, an instance of the moves holding a part.
detail.zh: Onward.within，持守一部分之步之实例。

detail.en: Branching.keeping, an instance of the moves holding a part.
detail.zh: Branching.keeping，持守一部分之步之实例。

detail.en: «续», «相续», «及», «类», «粗化», «及之单调», «线内同类», «不穷», «生», «复生», «息», «生生», «自不复生则息», «生生不息» and Steps.next: the held moves as continuations, what they reach as a line, and the course read on its moments, where they renew, cease or renew without end.
detail.zh: «续»、«相续»、«及»、«类»、«粗化»、«及之单调»、«线内同类»、«不穷»、«生»、«复生»、«息»、«生生»、«自不复生则息»、«生生不息» 与 Steps.next：持守之步即续，其所达即线，进程读于其时刻，于彼复生、息或 «生生»。

detail.en: «所闭当且仅当同一或及»: reach is the start or a reach of the steps.
detail.zh: «所闭当且仅当同一或及»：所达即起点或诸步之及。

detail.en: reach_iff_withinClosure: reach under a process read as the closure of its steps.
detail.zh: reach_iff_withinClosure：过程下之达读作其步之闭包。

detail.en: Amounts.unmarked_or_marked: the bounded search behind the located forms.
detail.zh: Amounts.unmarked_or_marked：可定位之形背后之有界搜索。

detail.en: Its third law, nothing added to the whole possible along a course of one process, read on a part held, a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top.
detail.zh: 其第三律（沿一过程之进程全部可能无所增），读于持守之部分、改变自身规则之规则与无顶之规则塔。

detail.en: Rules that change themselves read in the grammar's regularity; here read on what each configuration admits: the possible with the rule held grows only where the rule changes.
detail.zh: 于语法之常性中读自身改变之规则；此处读于各构型所纳：持守规则时之可能仅于规则改变处增长。

detail.en: Tasks and what performs them: holding the performing part throughout is sufficient for constructor theory's performance and not needed, and the held possible gives the premise of composition.
detail.zh: 任务与执行之者：全程持守执行之部分于构造子理论之执行充分而非必要，持守时之可能给出合成之前提。

detail.en: What can be born next against what continues: internal temporality is holding the past, so on causal-set growth the held possible is the whole possible.
detail.zh: 次可生者与相续：内在时间性即持守过去，故于因果集之生长上持守之可能即全部可能。

history.en: 27 October 2026: added (UE11), where the possible grows: a move adds nothing to the possible under its process; the possible relative to what is held grows only across a step changing what is held and keeps widening only where it changes without end, which does not suffice and which a course that only returns never has; a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top add nothing to the whole possible, every possibility of the tower had below some height, on the root as reach over a sequence growing coarser; growth relative to what is held and renewal without end are different relations; near-definitional; after a review and a re-check; study section 429.
history.zh: 2026年10月27日：新增（UE11），可能者于何处增长：一步不给其过程下之可能增添任何东西；相对于所持守者之可能仅于改变所持守者之步上增长，仅当该部分无尽地改变时持续扩大，而此不足，只回返之进程亦从无之；改变自身规则之规则与无顶之规则塔皆不给全部可能增添任何东西，塔之每一可能皆于某高度之下得之，于根上即渐粗之列上之及；相对于所持守者之增长与生生为不同之关系；近乎定义；经审查与复查；研究第 429 节。

A law added; statement and next step unchanged.
